items.title: DangoMatcha x Little V's Cafe journaling night
menu: exclusive Little V's matcha (one day only)
items.description: A junk-journaling night at a Hialeah cafe with matcha and coffee on hand and DangoMatcha sticker packs to journal with. The cafe is serving an exclusive matcha for this one day only.
items.notes: Date, time and street address are on the Eventbrite page. Matcha is a feature, not the whole point: a journaling social at a cafe. Hialeah is Miami metro. Price and ticketing not shown on the page.

items.title: Ceremony matcha class (ticketed)
items.description: A two-hour hands-on matcha class with Ceremony: learn traditional preparation, make your own, and taste several Ceremony drinks. The ticket covers one handcrafted latte.
items.notes: kind: class (ticketed, not walk-in). Snippet quotes: 'Join us Wednesday, November 25th, from 6-8 PM for a matcha class experience with Ceremony!' ... '370 Herron Dr, Suite 8, Nashville, TN'; ticket $65 includes a hands-on matcha-making experience, one handcrafted latte, samples. Post is by a host venue whose name the snippet does not show. Year inferred from posts dated Nov 2026. checked 2026-11-23: Instagram not opened; a web search found no public listing of this class (Ceremony runs pop-ups at Gladly Gather, 370 Herron Dr Ste 8, but no Nov 25 date on any public page).
